questions.question: What is partnership? Differentiate partnership with accompany.
questions.solution_html:
• What is partnership? Differentiate partnership with a company.
  • According to the Indian Partnership Act, 1932, partnership is the relation between
  • persons who have agreed to share the profits of a business carried on by all or any one of
  • them acting for all.
  • Partnership is formed through an agreement between two or more persons to conduct
  • business jointly. The persons are called par tners, and collectively they are known as a
  • firm.
  • Features of Partnership
  • • Existence of agreement between partners
  • • Sharing of profits and losses
  • • Mutual agency
  • • Lawful business
  • • Unlimited liability
  • • Utmost good faith among partners
  • • No separate legal entity
  • Difference between Partnership and Company
questions.final_answer: Difference between Partnership and Company
